name: Soybean
best_dish_use: Soy chunks, tofu, soy milk, soy suya, soy moi moi
nutrient_gap_or_caution: Low B12; trypsin inhibitors if undercooked

name: Tofu (awara)
best_dish_use: Tofu scramble, tofu pepper soup, fried tofu in stew, tofu suya
nutrient_gap_or_caution: Low B12; plant iron less absorbable
prep_note: Press, then fry or grill for a meat-like bite

name: Soy chunks (soya meat)
replaces_animal_protein: Beef, goat meat, chicken, shaki, sausage
best_dish_use: Stews, jollof, pepper soup, suya-style dishes
prep_note: Rehydrate, squeeze dry, then season and fry

name: Soy milk
nutrient_gap_or_caution: Low B12; calcium only if fortified

name: Cowpea (brown/white beans)
replaces_animal_protein: Beef, eggs (binder), fish in moi moi
best_dish_use: Moi moi, akara, ewa agoyin, bean patties
prep_note: Soak, peel, blend; pair with grain or egusi

name: Bambara nut
prep_note: Soak overnight; milling to flour saves time

name: African yam bean
prep_note: Soak and cook long; pressure cooker helps

name: Groundnut
replaces_animal_protein: Cow milk, cheese, meat in sauces
nutrient_gap_or_caution: Low lysine; aflatoxin risk if poorly stored
prep_note: Buy fresh, store dry, discard mouldy nuts

name: Kuli-kuli
best_dish_use: Suya-style crumb, topping, crunchy protein snack
nutrient_gap_or_caution: Aflatoxin risk if poorly stored; lower fat

name: Egusi (melon seed)
best_dish_use: Egusi soup, egusi balls, binder in patties

name: Pumpkin seed (ugu seed)
best_dish_use: Roasted snacks, soup thickener, meat-style crumble

name: Ogbono (bush mango seed)
prep_note: Grind and add to hot oil

name: Locust bean (iru/dawadawa)
prep_note: Rinse lightly; use as seasoning base

name: Oil bean seed (ugba)
nutrient_gap_or_caution: Used in small amounts; check hygiene
prep_note: Buy from trusted sellers; wash well

name: Oyster mushroom
best_dish_use: Mushroom suya, asun, pepper soup, peppered snail
prep_note: Tear into strips, sear until dry, then season

name: Cricket (dried)
best_dish_use: Cricket flour in stews, crayfish substitute

name: Termite (alate)
prep_note: Source from reputable sellers; cook well

name: Spirulina

nutrient_gap_or_caution: Used in small amounts; limited supply

name: Avocado

name: African pear
best_dish_use: Eaten with corn or roasted plantain; creamy sauces
